# Third-party demo motorcycle photos

**Reviewed**: 2026-10-30
**Scope**: `apps/web/public/bike-photos/`
**Used by**: `packages/db/src/seed.ts` demo fleet and the public bike card

The bundled demo photos come from Wikimedia Commons. Each retained file was verified by
downloading the linked Commons file (or its 1280 px thumbnail) and comparing the SHA-256 digest
with the local file. The digests matched exactly, so the author and license below belong to the
same bytes that are served by the app.

`ducati-scrambler.jpg`, `honda-cb500f.jpg`, `honda-vision.jpg`, `honda-winner-x.jpg`, and
`suzuki-raider.jpg` are the 1280 px versions generated by Wikimedia Commons; that resize is the
only modification. The other two files are the original Commons uploads.

Attribution is rendered on the public bike card by `apps/web/app/components/BikePhoto.vue` using
the mapping in `apps/web/app/utils/photoCredits.ts`. The same table must be updated if a photo is
replaced.

`apps/web/scripts/fetch-bike-photos.mjs` re-downloads exactly these seven files by Commons title.
Do not replace it with a text search: the first search result is not a license review.

## Removed files

These files were deleted from the branch before publication because the exact source could not be
confirmed, and the KTM photo showed a different model than the seeded bike:

- `honda-xr150l.jpg` — no matching Commons file; license unknown.
- `yamaha-xtz150.jpg` — no matching Commons file; license unknown.
- `ktm-390-adventure.jpg` — the source was a public-domain KTM Duke 390 photo, not a 390 Adventure.

The three seeded motorcycles now use the built-in `BikePhoto` placeholder until the owner supplies
their own photos or a verified replacement is added here first.
